what: A table of contents with one 25px dot per section in that section’s color, stood vertically. The dot of the last section whose top edge has passed the screen center swells in .5s into a 90px photo circle with the photo inside turning on, and a hovered dot swells too. Pressing a dot or the up·down buttons glides to that section’s top edge by the original’s frame table: distance/30 frames (10~60, one step per frame), each step being start + distance × p × easeInOutCubic(p), so it rushes toward the end. The n / total number changes together. Above the first section (the Hero), no dot is lit.

options.line: Screen height ratio at which a section counts as current, default .5
options.speed: Distance per slide frame (px) — number of frames = Distance/speed, default 30
options.min · max: Slide frame count, lower and upper bounds, default 10 · 60
options.--fx-size · --fx-open · --fx-gap · --fx-: Dot size · swollen size · dot gap · swell duration, default 25px · 90px · 20px · .5s
options.--fx-dot: Dot color (set per dot via style), default --kf-accent
options.fx:rail: Event the element emits each time the section changes (detail.index·target)

use: • …

from.where: index.html .vn-rail (right-side index for the ten Work sections) — original MyTop sectionation (.o_top-work_sectionationListItem 25px → -on · :hover 90px, width · height .5s, img opacity .5s) + smoothScrollTo (BASE_SPEED 30 · MIN_FRAME 10 · MAX_FRAME 60 · easeInOutCubic)

note: The original hides the dot row at 980px and below and keeps only the up and down buttons — the consuming css [data-fx-part=Just hide list]. A wheel or touch during the slide stops it
